title: observability: token/KV cost & latency dashboards + tracing + alert tuning
author: Priya Raman
description: Adds a consolidated token-level + KV cache observability dashboard, expands tracing spans for KV/cache interactions, and retunes related alerts. Motivation: enable SRE and runtime teams to diagnose tail-latency and cost regressions that are driven by KV cache behavior and token-level serving characteristics. This PR includes: 1) new Grafana dashboard (Token/KV Cost & Latency) with panels for token-level p50/p95/p99 latency, token-level cost-per-1k tokens, KV cache hit/miss rates, average KV retrieval latency, per-model token-cost breakdown, and request heatmaps by sequence length; 2) added tracing spans for kv.fetch, kv.cache_miss, kv.deserialize, and runtime.batch_split so traces link to dashboard metrics; 3) new derived metrics (token_kv_cache_hit_rate, token_kv_avg_latency_ms, token_cost_per_1k_usd) instrumented in the serving runtime metrics exporter; 4) alert tuning: lower-noise thresholds for high-severity alerts (p99 token latency, KV miss rate) and new warning-level alerts for rising token-cost; 5) runbook links and dashboard links in alert messages for faster incident response; 6) unit/integration tests and a Grafana JSON model that can be imported by the console provisioning script. Checklist: - [x] Instrument metrics in runtime exporter - [x] Add tracing spans and update trace schema - [x] Create Grafana dashboard JSON and console provisioning changes - [x] Add CI tests for metrics name and dashboard schema - [x] Document runbook and alert rationale in release notes

review_thread:
Liam O'Connor: Can we avoid high-cardinality tags on token-level metrics? Suggest aggregation by model+route.
Priya Raman: Agree — metrics expose model and route but we add a routed_aggregation label and document cost of cardinality in docs.

Jae Kim: Alert thresholds look noisy for low-traffic models; recommend scaling thresholds by 99th percentile of request rate.
Priya Raman: Implemented adaptive-threshold suggestion and added suppression window for models below 100 req/min.

Marisol Ortega: Tracing span names and attributes LGTM; please ensure spans don't add >1ms overhead in hot path.
Priya Raman: Measured overhead in microbench and added guard to only emit detailed spans when tracing sampling is on.
Liam O'Connor: Approving pending small wording change in runbook.
testing_and_validation: unit tests for metric names and instrumentation: added
integration smoke tests for dashboard import: pass
performance microbench: tracing overhead <0.6ms at p95 when sampling=1%
release_notes: Observability: Added Token/KV Cost & Latency dashboard, new token-level KV metrics and tracing spans, and tuned alerts to reduce noise while surfacing cost/latency regressions. This improves SRE's ability to debug tail latency and cost spikes tied to KV caching behavior.
backout_plan: Revert grafana JSON and alert rules, and disable token-level metrics via feature flag if we see unexpected cardinality or cost impact.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-4387: automated sampling calibration for traced spans
ENG-4410: gradual rollout of token-level metrics by customer tier
ENG-4442: console UI for toggling token-level panels per-org
user_impact: Low-risk: observability-only changes. Metrics and dashboards are additive; tracing spans are gated by sampling. No serving behavior changes.
notes: This PR consolidates prior efforts (see ENG-4312) and is the landing point for runtime token-level observability work. Dashboard JSON included for console provisioning; operations should import to staging prior to GA rollout.
